front.title: Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP) Extension for Link CRC Error Measurement

abstract.t: The Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP), specified in RFC 8762, supports active measurement of network performance. This document defines a STAMP Type-Length-Value (TLV) that reports receive-side link statistics: packets received, packets received with Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) errors, and bytes received. The link is identified using the Micro-session ID TLV specified in RFC 9534. These measurements support fiber-quality monitoring to provide SLA assurance.
